mapper.insert: INSERT INTO campus_ingest_run_log ( run_id, task_id, run_status, trigger_type, start_time, fetched_count, success_count, duplicate_count, invalid_count, detection_trigger_count, detection_hit_count, detection_alert_count, detection_error_message, fail_count, error_message, error_type, retry_count, scheduler_node, create_user_id ) VALUES ( #{runId}, #{taskId}, #{runStatus}, #{triggerType}, #{startTime}, #{fetchedCount}, #{successCount}, #{duplicateCount}, #{invalidCount}, #{detectionTriggerCount}, #{detectionHitCount}, #{detectionAlertCount}, #{detectionErrorMessage}, #{failCount}, #{errorMessage}, #{errorType}, #{retryCount}, #{schedulerNode}, #{createUserId} )
